title: Law to allow parking stickers for street cleaning violations
summary: This bill would repeal the 2012 ban on using adhesive stickers to enforce alternate side parking rules, letting the Department of Transportation and the Department of Sanitation again place a sticker on vehicles that violate street cleaning parking rules. The sticker could be up to 8.5 by 11 inches and placed on a vehicle's window. DSNY had previously said the stickers deterred repeat violators and improved street cleanliness ratings.
